scraped.title: IPA 2022 Multi-beneficiary statistical cooperation programme
scraped.subtitle: IPA 2022 Multi-beneficiary statistical cooperation programme
scraped.description: The ICON's scope of work involves, first and foremost, providing expertise through statistical projects aimed at enhancing the production, collection, and dissemination of high-quality statistics. The services encompass various elements:
body: The ICON's scope of work involves, first and foremost, providing expertise through statistical projects aimed at enhancing the production, collection, and dissemination of high-quality statistics. The services encompass various elements:
Managing 25 statistical projects
Conducting evaluations, assessments, and analyses of data availability, as well as ensuring compliance with EU requirements in methodology and procedures.
Proposing short and medium-term improvements based on evaluations.
Organizing workshops, training courses, consultancies, study visits, in-country events, regional events, and other activities to explain EU requirements in detail.
Assisting in organizing traineeships.
Providing technical assistance for data collection, treatment, analysis, and dissemination through missions and help desks.
Additionally, ICON organizes peer/sector reviews of partner countries according to Eurostat methodology.
